intent: Parametric packaging study, not a competition-ready mechanism

coralReference.note: Nominal 4-inch Schedule 40 PVC, 11-7/8 inch long. Verify official tolerances before design release. Staged ahead of intake, not simulated contact.

acceptance: Create nine separate solids including a clearly named non-BOM coral reference
Create two shaft bores, two crossmember mount holes, and one pivot hole per plate
Roller sleeves have shaft bores; crossmembers may be solid packaging envelopes
Revise inner width to 360 and clear roller gap to 95 without recreating the document
Measure server-side part count, bounds, holes, feature errors, and revision values
Obtain Onshape-rendered image and STEP export when authenticated
Record actual calls, failures, retries, elapsed time, and human interventions
Never count local source generation or a mock response as Onshape CAD success
